title: Tranche losses under dependent defaults
prompt: Losses are positive for losses and negative for gains. VaR at alpha is inf{x: P(loss<=x)>=alpha}; ES is the mean of the worst 1-alpha probability mass, taking only the necessary fraction of any boundary atom. Three names have exposures10,15,20 USD million and deterministic60% LGD. First choose benign or stress regime with probabilities.8,.2. Conditional on regime, names default independently with the SAME PD for every name: .02 or.25 respectively. A loss layer bears pool losses above10 up to20, so it can lose at most10. There is no discounting, premium or mark-to-market. Report expected layer loss, probability it is fully exhausted,95% ES of layer loss, and expected layer loss under the deliberately different model making all defaults unconditionally independent with the same marginal PDs.

outputs.name: expected_layer_loss
outputs.description: Expected loss of10-to20 layer under common-factor model.

outputs.name: independent_expected_layer_loss
outputs.description: Expected layer loss under unconditional independence with same PDs.
